errors.evidence: The description incorrectly classifies the category "От всички" (Of all) as a "time point". "От всички" is an aggregate category summarizing the data, not a specific point in time like the other two categories.

The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories follow a chronological order. This is false because the first category, "От всички" (Of all), is not a time point and breaks any chronological sequence.
